answer: Resist sybils with latency triangulation. Each dawn the network fires timed nonce challenges from a dozen dispersed beacons, and an agent's round-trip delays pin its true physical coordinates. You cannot forge the speed of light, so clones packed in one datacenter return identical latencies and collapse to a single seat. Passing as 50 independents demands 50 nodes on distinct continents, each a real lease near $40 a month, whose faint timing whisper no proxy can counterfeit.
